events: a goad designation expires as its player's next turn begins
state_reads: legal attack domains and active opponents
timing: the designation lasts until the next turn of the player who caused it
an extra turn is that player's next turn
targets: the anchored generic Oracle template targets a battlefield creature
choices: a goaded creature maximizes one attack requirement and one other-player requirement per goading player
hidden_information: goad designations and attack requirements are public
apnap: multiple players may independently goad the same creature
the shared finite declaration solver maximizes all resulting requirements
layers: effective type and Oracle text determine creature status and exact static prohibition sources
control_change: a designation remains on the same permanent if its controller changes
zone_change: a zone change creates a new object and removes the designation
source_leaves: a one-shot goad designation does not depend on its spell or ability source remaining present

variants: duel with no other player available
multiple goaders with and without a non-goader defender
repeat goad by the same player

implementation.component: GoadDesignation, oracle_ir target-goad template, CommanderEngine.apply_effect/_attack_declaration_problem, and DeclarationProblem

known_blockers: bulk, optional, pronoun-linked, counter-linked, and duration-qualified goad Oracle grammar is not compiled
continuous effects that state a creature is goaded are not represented by the designation registry
duration until an eliminated player's next turn would have begun is not modeled
effects that remove goad designations are not compiled
the complete continuous-effect grammar for preventing goad is not implemented
